mappingNote: ICD-11 distinguishes episode count: Single episode depressive disorder is 6A70, Recurrent depressive disorder is 6A71. DSM Major Depressive Disorder maps to whichever applies; the parent block is 6A7Z if unspecified.

description.en: Persistent sadness, loss of interest, and functional impairment lasting at least 2 weeks
